name: Frost Brand

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Quench Flames
powers.text: Magic action: put out every nonmagical flame within 30 ft (once an hour).

summary: An extra 1d6 Cold on every hit, Resistance to Fire while you hold it, and it can snuff out flames.
text: Holding this magic weapon gives you Resistance to Fire damage, and every hit with it deals an extra 1d6 Cold damage. When the air is freezing it glows, giving off Bright Light out to 10 feet and Dim Light for 10 feet past that. As you draw it, you can snuff out every nonmagical flame within 30 feet of you; then this property needs 1 hour to recharge.
